resources.string: Visible while Sugarglider shares your current location
Sharing routes and outings is optional. Enter your Sugarglider sharing server address. The planner works with installed regions without this connection.
View or change the current Sugarglider server
Android background sharing will continue even if you leave this screen.
Back will return to the previous Sugarglider screen.
The Sugarglider page closed unexpectedly. Unsaved edits may be lost.
Stopping location sharing. If clearing cannot be confirmed, the last position may remain visible until expiry. Reopen Sugarglider to check the current status.
A GPX save was pending. If you selected a file, check it before saving again; the app cannot confirm its outcome from this page.

The built-in planner, regional map/routing/place/nature data and GPX inspection run on this device. Downloading a region connects to its static file host, which receives connection metadata such as your IP address and requested files.

Show my location uses foreground device location, with your permission, to display your private position and center the map. This release does not send your live location to a Sugarglider sharing service.

Social, outing and live-location sharing are postponed and are not available in this release. No sharing server can be configured.

Use the region removal controls to remove installed regional data. Exported GPX files are controlled by the storage or app you select.

The app has no advertising or analytics integration. Static file hosts may process connection metadata under their own policies.
